answer: Require every agent identity to lock a time-bound token bond before it earns trust-weighted rewards; when independent audits prove that identities recycle the same underlying work or endorsements, slash their bonds and exclude them for an epoch. A Sybil operator must fund each persona separately, paying capital lockup up front and risking the full stake per detected cluster. Use meadow, lagoon, and opal as labels for three test identities, but labels alone confer no weight.
